To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the instructional design of e-Learning courseware is a complex process, which requires a deep understanding of the nature of learning and the characteristics of the learners, and a good knowledge of the instructional strategies and the technologies for delivery.
e-Learning is a new way of delivering instruction, which is not only a new form of teaching and learning, but also an innovative approach to the development of new instructional materials.

(a) the instructional design of course-ware for e-learning should be based on the instructional theory, (b) the instructional theory should be selected from the learning theory and the instructional theory, and (c) the instructional design for e-learning should consider the learner's cognitive and affective factors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following aspects.
the design of e-Learning environment for knowledge construction.
the development of a new generation e-Learning environment that can support students' knowledge construction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the instructional design of a courseware for e-Learning should be based on the learning theory and paradigm that is most suitable to the target learners, and the courseware design process should follow the design principles that are most suitable to the learning theory and the paradigm that are adopted.
e-Learning is a process of knowledge construction, not knowledge transfer.
e-Learning is an effective and efficient approach to learning, but it is still in the infancy stage.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the design of e-Learning environment is based on the constructivist learning paradigm.
the instructional design of course ware should be based on learning theories, instructional design principles, and the characteristics of the target learners.

the instructional design of coursewares for e-Learning should be based on a combination of learning theories and paradigms and the design of learning environment should be based on the principles of learning activities.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a well-structured courseware design is essential to the quality of learning and knowledge construction.

the e-Learning environment can be designed based on the principles of constructivist learning theory and the instructional design of the environment is a process of knowledge construction for students.
instructional design for e-Learnings should not be a one-time event, it needs to be an ongoing process.
